svg.text: The sweep's numbers come back as numbers, its holes as None.
Day 81 typed the verdict and left every other column a string, so a notebook's first cell was cleaning.
Today read_sweep knows the columns ArmDelta.row() writes, and which of them are allowed to be empty.

g.text: an ungraded split boot writes None, csv writes ""
r["graphs_itl_p50_ms"] "20.0" (a string)
float(r["split_measured"]) ValueError, deep in a plot
bool(r["split_pays"]) True, from the word "False"
int(float(r["itl_samples"])) 12.5 quietly becomes 12
every notebook guesses what "" means,
and "did not pay" can plot as "paid"
*_ms *_speedup *_tok_s float (FLOAT_SUFFIXES)
replay_share split_read_error float (FLOAT_COLUMNS)
split_predicted split_measured
itl_samples graphs_held ... int (INT_COLUMNS)
split_pays "True" / "False" only
load, anything it did not write left as text
NULLABLE_COLUMNS = tuple(SplitBoot().row())
The split boot's own keys: the only cells a sweep
ever writes empty. "" there is None, nowhere else.

svg.text: what it refuses (ValueError, column and row named)

g.text: graphs_itl_p50_ms = "" a measurement with a hole
eager_tok_s = "fast" a word in a number
itl_samples = "12.5" a count that is not whole
split_pays = "yes" a third word for a bool
an empty cell outside the split boot is a row
that did not measure, not a zero and not a None
plus Day 81's header and subset refusals, unchanged

svg.text: how a card sweep's notebook starts now

g.text: 1. read, filter, plot. No cleaning cell.
rows = read_sweep("card.csv")
rows = [r for r in rows if r["claims_unsound"] == []]
plot([r["itl_p50_speedup"] for r in rows])
2. a written row reads back equal, same type
Two-arm and three-arm, every key, value and type.
toy sweep smoke's real CSV reads back typed, no "" left
